notes: 'wild asses' heads on 'asses' by rule 31's ASV-usage test (the chapter writes bare 'ass' for חֲמוֹר in v.3); competing head 'wild' named in the unit.
'yieldeth' is a supplied lexical verb in a verbless clause (rule 20); the dative לְ is unrepresented and its suffix takes the written 'them' (rule 40).
Article before נְעָרִים takes the possessive 'their' written in its place (rule 41).
